observations: Bear It's rules plus a timed worker gate; rewards follow gates (S2-b, S4-a) or set the approach lane (S3-b).
Single landing boxes become a 10-box landing field after the big hole; its first box is where an angled-left jump lands.
Only 4 explosives in 42 boxes, each a key: TNT heading a line dictates order, a TNT forces a jump, a Nitro pair is a strip-wide hurdle.
Ice pairs return escalated (W+? from the left, then striped+? from the middle with instant hold-right).
Occlusion behind totems hides a ? and C3, the only hidden placement in the bear stages, flagged on the perfect page.
A 2x2 opening block banks 10% of the boxes before any hazard.
Density peaks in S2 (15); S3 is a deliberate calm (POINT 11) before the hidden-box forest.
The fruit trail can lead away from the box line (S3-c).
The live warp icon is a box-less hidden exit.
openQuestions: Plain icons identified only as non-?/non-striped are wood? (could be striped).
S1-a and S4-c lanes medium confidence.
